meta.ogDescription: Fakes upload and download stats of a torrent to almost all BitTorrent trackers. Open source, for Windows, Linux and macOS.
donate.title: We need your donations!
donate.text: RatioMaster.NET has been free since 2005. If it is useful to you, a donation keeps it going.
news.title: Latest news
news.v12: The program now speaks 38 languages, and so does this site. The closed-source clients were read from their own code: new BitComet 2.22 and BitTorrent 7.11.0 emulations, uTorrent 3.6.0 at its current build, and current qBittorrent, Deluge, rTorrent, Vuze and BitTornado.
news.v11: The client emulations were checked against the real clients’ source code and brought up to date: current qBittorrent, Deluge, Vuze, BitTorrent and uTorrent builds, a new rTorrent emulation, and a fixed Transmission peer id.
news.v10: A complete rewrite: one self-contained file for Windows, Linux and macOS, https trackers, a new interface with light and dark themes, and a qBittorrent emulation.
news.openSourced: The project is now completely open source. The code is on GitHub and pull requests are welcome.
download.lead: RatioMaster.NET is a small standalone application which fakes upload and download stats of a torrent to almost all BitTorrent trackers.
download.notAClient: This means that it does not rely on your BitTorrent client (qBittorrent, uTorrent, Azureus, BitComet and others) and it will not download or upload the files of a torrent. It can only fake the download and upload statistics reported to the tracker.
download.emulations: RatioMaster.NET has built-in emulations of 32 versions of the most commonly used BitTorrent clients: qBittorrent, uTorrent, BitComet, Vuze, BitTorrent, rTorrent, Transmission, ABC, BitLord, BTuga, BitTornado, Burst, BitTyrant, BitSpirit, Deluge, KTorrent and Gnome BT. Version 1.2 is a single self-contained file: nothing to install, no .NET Framework and no Mono.
download.windowsHint: Unzip and run RatioMaster.NET.exe. Settings from 0.43 are picked up on the first start.
download.linuxHint: Needs libfontconfig1, libx11-6, libice6 and libsm6, which most desktops already have.
download.macHint: The app is not notarized: right-click it and choose Open the first time, or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine RatioMaster.NET.app.
download.allVersions: All versions and the source code are on GitHub Releases. The program is open source under the MIT License.
features.title: Program features
features.torrents: Runs any number of torrents at once, each with its own client emulation and speeds.
features.platforms: Windows, Linux and macOS, as one self-contained file with nothing to install.
features.languages: Speaks 38 languages and starts in the language of your system.
features.torrentFiles: Automatically loads the torrent info from the torrent file; drag and drop torrents and sessions onto the window.
features.sessions: Sessions: save the current torrents with their settings and load them later; the last session is restored on startup.
features.emulations: Very strong protection against anti-cheat scripts: byte-exact emulation of 32 client versions across 17 families, including qBittorrent, uTorrent, BitComet, Vuze, BitTorrent, rTorrent, Transmission and Deluge. Their current versions are checked against the real clients’ own code, and emulations that nobody runs any more, or that could not be checked, are dropped rather than kept to make the number bigger.
features.copyFromClient: Copies the peer id, key, port and peer count out of a running uTorrent, Azureus, BitComet or ABC.
features.speeds: Selectable upload and download speeds, with optional random jitter and a fresh random speed on every tracker update.
features.tracker: Honours the tracker’s announce interval, scrapes for seeders and leechers, and follows redirects.
features.stopConditions: Stops automatically after a time, or when seeders, leechers, uploaded, downloaded or the leecher/seeder ratio crosses a limit.
features.noLeechers: Pauses the upload while the tracker reports no leechers: with nobody downloading there is nobody to upload to.
features.connectable: Answers incoming peer handshakes on the announced port so the torrent looks connectable.
features.network: Works with http and https trackers, over IPv4 and IPv6, directly or through an HTTP CONNECT, SOCKS4, SOCKS4a or SOCKS5 proxy.
features.realTime: Shows uploaded, downloaded, ratio, speeds, swarm size and the next update, all in real time.
features.log: Keeps a per-torrent log and a record of every tracker exchange with its request, response and timing.
features.themes: Light and dark themes, following the system by default.
features.customClients: Custom announce values and your own client emulations through a clients.json file.
features.trackers: Works with almost all BitTorrent trackers.

changelog.title: Program changelog
changelog.full: The full changelog since 2005 is in HISTORY.TXT.
changelog.v120.languages: Global: the program speaks 38 languages. It starts in the display language of the system, and Settings > General > Language picks another one. Arabic and Hebrew lay the window out from right to left, and sizes and speeds use the units of the chosen language.
changelog.v120.emulations: RM: new emulations: qBittorrent 5.2.4 (now the default), Deluge 2.2.0, BitTornado 0.3.18, rTorrent 0.16.25, Vuze 5.7.6.0, BitComet 2.22 and BitTorrent 7.11.0, and uTorrent 3.6.0 moves to its current build, 47254. BitComet, uTorrent and BitTorrent are closed source, so they were read from the clients themselves.
changelog.v120.hostPort: RM: the Host header of every announce now carries the tracker’s port when it is not the default one, as the real clients write it.
changelog.v120.escaping: RM: each emulation percent-encodes the info hash and the peer id the way its client does, and every announce goes out exactly as built.
changelog.v120.uTorrent: RM: the uTorrent peer id ends in the two check bytes the real client puts there instead of random ones, and the port comes from the range uTorrent uses.
changelog.v120.vuze: RM: fixed the Vuze emulations: a default Vuze asks for 75 peers while downloading and 37 while seeding, not always 100, and picks its port from 10000-65535.
changelog.v120.details: RM: fixed details of the rTorrent 0.9.6 and BitTornado emulations, read from their source code.
changelog.v120.removed: RM: removed the uTorrent 3.5.5, uTorrent 3.5.4 and BitTorrent 7.10.3 emulations, whose code could not be checked. A saved torrent that used one of them now runs with the default client.
changelog.v120.columns: Global: columns widen to fit a longer translated header, values in the torrent list no longer get cut off, and the toolbar buttons have names for screen readers.
changelog.v110.noLeechers: RM: new option “Pause the upload while the tracker reports no leechers”, on by default. With nobody downloading there is nobody to upload to, so reporting upload anyway is the easiest way to get noticed.
changelog.v110.transmission: RM: fixed the Transmission peer id. The real client ends it with a check digit that makes the twelve generated characters add up to a multiple of 36; ours were random, so roughly 35 out of every 36 peer ids we sent could be spotted as fake.
changelog.v110.key: RM: the uTorrent and BitTorrent emulations now generate a new tracker key every 10 minutes while a torrent runs. The key used to stay the same for the whole session, which stood out on a long seed.
changelog.v110.numwant: RM: the stopped announce now asks for no peers (numwant=0), as every real client does.
changelog.v110.emulations: RM: new emulations: qBittorrent 5.1.4 and 4.6.7, uTorrent 3.5.4, Deluge 2.1.1, Vuze 5.7.5.0, BitTorrent 7.10.3, Transmission 2.94 and 3.00, and a new rTorrent 0.9.6.
changelog.v110.removed: RM: removed the emulations of clients that are long out of use: six Azureus versions, Vuze 4.2.0.8, Deluge 1.2.0 and 0.5.x, uTorrent 3.3.2 and 3.3.0, BitTorrent 6.0.3 and Transmission 2.82 and 2.92. A saved torrent that used one of them now runs with the default client.
changelog.v110.randomBytes: RM: fixed the random bytes in several peer ids being drawn from 0-254, so they could contain a zero byte and could never contain 0xff; the real clients use 1-255.
changelog.v110.checked: Code: the emulations are now checked against the BitTorrent clients’ own published source code, and every announce is pinned byte for byte by a test.
changelog.v100.rewrite: Global: complete rewrite on .NET 10; the program now runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.
changelog.v100.singleFile: Global: single self-contained file, nothing to install and no .NET Framework needed.
changelog.v100.interface: Global: new interface with one row per torrent and a details pane, replacing the tabbed layout.
changelog.v100.themes: Global: light and dark themes, following the system by default.
changelog.v100.bytesRoad: Global: removed the bundled GPL BytesRoad socket library; all networking is plain .NET now.
changelog.v100.https: RM: https trackers are supported (the old raw socket code could not do TLS at all).
changelog.v100.proxies: RM: proxies rewritten: HTTP CONNECT, SOCKS4, SOCKS4a and SOCKS5 with username/password.
changelog.v100.qBittorrent: RM: new client emulation: qBittorrent 5.2.3, the default for new installs.
changelog.v100.clientsJson: RM: client emulations moved out of the code into clients.json, so they can be added without a rebuild; a clients.json in the configuration folder can add or override emulations.
changelog.v100.interval: RM: the tracker announce interval is now honoured up to 24 hours instead of being capped at 1 hour.
changelog.v100.trackerTab: RM: new Tracker tab showing every announce and scrape with its request, response and timing.
changelog.v100.log: RM: the log is virtualised, so a long-running torrent no longer slows the interface down.
changelog.v100.settings: RM: settings and sessions are JSON; settings moved out of the registry. Settings from 0.43 are imported on first run and session files written by 0.43 still load.
changelog.v100.session: RM: the last session is restored on startup.
changelog.v100.updateCheck: RM: the update check uses https and no longer sends your Windows user name.
changelog.v100.headers: RM: fixed malformed request headers in the BitTyrant, KTorrent, BitSpirit and Gnome BT emulations, and the Deluge emulations sending the event parameter twice.
changelog.v100.tests: Code: the core is a separate library with no interface dependencies, covered by 255 tests.
changelog.v043.openSource: Global: the program is now open source and the source is available on GitHub.
changelog.v043.about: Global: program information, links and the About form updated.
changelog.v043.time: RM: time displayed in logs can now be adjusted to a 24h format (thanks to sywesk).
changelog.v043.emulations: RM: new client emulations: uTorrent 3.3.2, uTorrent 3.3.0, uTorrent 3.2.0, Transmission 2.82 (14160).
changelog.v043.default: RM: default client is now uTorrent 3.3.2.
changelog.v043.proxies: RM: proxies fixed for localhost (thanks to ghost).
changelog.v042.renamed: RM: program renamed from “NRPG RatioMaster” to “RatioMaster.NET”.
changelog.v042.sites: RM: program and author sites changed to ratiomaster.net and nikolay.it.
changelog.v042.emulations: RM: new client emulations: uTorrent 2.0.1 (build 19078), uTorrent 1.8.5 (build 17414), BitComet 1.20, Vuze 4.2.0.8, BitSpirit 3.6.0.200, Deluge 1.2.0.
changelog.v042.default: RM: default client is now uTorrent 1.8.5 (build 17414).
changelog.v041.vista: RM: fixed the memory reader on all Vista systems.
changelog.v041.interface: RM: some very small interface changes.
changelog.v041.versionChecker: RM: some improvements in the version checker.
changelog.v041.emulations: RM: new client emulations: uTorrent 1.8.0, uTorrent 1.8.1-beta (11903), Azureus 3.1.1.0, Azureus 3.0.5.0, BitComet 1.03, BitTorrent 6.0.3 (8642), Deluge 0.5.8.7, Deluge 0.5.8.6.
changelog.v041.types: RM: new client types: BitTorrent, Deluge.
changelog.v041.default: RM: default client is now uTorrent 1.8.0.
